description: This file defines functions related to validating defect status transitions and associated root cause requirements within a defect tracking system. It utilizes FastAPI for HTTP exception handling and references project-specific constants and classes.

classes.name: DefectStatus
classes.description: Enum representing the possible statuses of a defect in the workflow.

methods.name: bool _root_cause_required(for_status: DefectStatus)
methods.description: Determines if a root cause is required for a given defect status.

methods.name: None validate_defect_transition( *, current_status: DefectStatus, new_status: DefectStatus, root_cause: str | None )
methods.description: Checks whether a transition from current to new defect status is valid, and if a root cause is necessary.

methods.name: None validate_root_cause_for_status(*, status_value: DefectStatus, root_cause: str | None)
methods.description: Ensures that a root cause is provided when the defect status currently requires one.

ctags.name: validate_defect_transition
ctags.signature: ( *, current_status: DefectStatus, new_status: DefectStatus, root_cause: str | None )

ctags.name: validate_root_cause_for_status
ctags.pattern: /^def validate_root_cause_for_status(*, status_value: DefectStatus, root_cause: str | None) -> Non/
